title: ESPD Instance Data — Part II
description: EXPERIMENTAL canonical instance-data model for Part II of the ESPD standard form: information concerning the economic operator. Covers EO01 (general information), EO05 (lots tendered for — a repeating scalar), and EO06 (representatives — a repeating object).

lots.description: Lot(s) the economic operator wishes to tender for (EO05/QG1/Q1), if the procedure is divided into lots. Maps to a repeating cac:ProcurementProjectLot element, one per array entry. Absent or empty when the economic operator tenders for the whole procedure (not divided into lots).

items.description: The identifier of a lot referenced in Part I / the procurement documents.

representatives.description: Representatives of the economic operator (EO06). Maps to repeating cac:Person elements under cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:Party. At least one representative is expected (EO06/QG1 has cardinality 1..n).

economicOperator.description: General information about the economic operator (EO01). Aligned to espd:EconomicOperator / epo:EconomicOperator.

identifier.description: Registration identifier of the economic operator (EO01/Q2 VAT registration number, or Q3 as a fallback when no VAT number applies). The two form questions are alternatives for the same underlying registration identifier, so they are modeled as a single structured value rather than two separate fields.

scheme.description: EOIDType code identifying the kind of identifier (e.g. VAT, NATIONAL, LEI, BRIS, DUNS).

address.description: Postal address of the economic operator (EO01/Q4–Q7).

country.description: Country of the economic operator, as a bare country code (EO01/Q7).

contact.description: Ways to reach the economic operator (EO01/Q8–Q10). This groups telephone, e-mail and website together as a data-modeling choice; they do not necessarily share a single location in the UBL XML — that is a mapping concern, not a data-model concern.

website.description: Internet address (web address) of the economic operator (EO01/Q10).

representative.description: A representative of the economic operator (EO06). Maps to one cac:Person under cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:Party. Note: EO06/Q11 ('detailed information on representation — its forms, extent, purpose') has no corresponding field in UBL's PersonType and is deliberately not modeled here; there is no natural XML target for it yet.

givenName.description: Given (first) name of the representative. The form (EO06/Q1) asks for the full name as a single question, but UBL's cac:Person splits it into cbc:FirstName and cbc:FamilyName, so the instance model follows the UBL split rather than the form's single field.

familyName.description: Family (last) name of the representative. See note on givenName.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the representative (EO06/Q2).

placeOfBirth.description: Place of birth of the representative (EO06/Q3).

position.description: Position held / capacity in which the representative is acting (EO06/Q10).
